title: Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Invoicing Note — Platform Fee for the Month of Activation
content:
**Proration clause.** A Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service activated during the billing month has a billed-part multiplier of one third on that month's platform fee when it was activated after day 20 of the month and of two thirds when it was activated after day 10 but no later than day 20; any other service has a billed-part multiplier of one.

The activation date is the date on the service record on which business verification and the first deposit activated the service; the billing month is the completed calendar month the platform fee is for.

| Activation | Billed part of the billing month |
|---|---|
| during the billing month, on day 1 to day 10 | one |
| during the billing month, on day 11 to day 20 | two thirds |
| during the billing month, on day 21 or later | one third |
| in an earlier month | one |

## Boundary days (hypothetical)

- Activated on day 10 of the billing month: not after day 10, so one.
- Activated on day 11: after day 10 and no later than day 20, so two thirds.
- Activated on day 20: two thirds. Activated on day 21: after day 20, so one third.
- Activated in the month before the billing month, on any day: one.
